# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Supply risk stays elevated (70.6) and price pressure intensifies (84.0); lock‑in pricing where advised, otherwise push for lead‑time guarantees.

## What changed
- Overall market supply risk unchanged at 70.6 (neutral change) and price trend unchanged at 84.0 [1][2].  
- All five segments show “Rising” supply risk (scores 64‑71) and “Rising” price trends (scores 79‑85) with high confidence [3][4][5][6][7].  
- Drivers remain strong: Semiconductor PPI +9.1% annualized, global chip sales +146 % YoY, TSMC revenue +50.9 % YoY, and Korea export surge +171 % YoY [1‑4].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, channel stock 27,211 units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price $5.56 for qty‑1, $2.51 for 1 k units; origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate (14‑week lead, 17.7 weeks of stock) [8].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply 69.6 (Rising), price 79.5 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply 71.4 (Elevated), price 84.7 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – supply 64.8 (Rising), price 83.1 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – supply 69.0 (Rising), price 83.4 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 64.1 (Rising), price 82.2 (Rising), Medium confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – supply risk 82.9 (Elevated); 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – supply risk 82.9 (Elevated); 52‑week lead time.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – supply risk 82.9 (Elevated); 52‑week lead time, price +60 % vs target.  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – supply risk 82.4 (Elevated); 52‑week lead time, price +1,717 % vs target.  
- **MT40A1G16TB-062E:F** – supply risk 82.4 (Elevated); 52‑week lead time, price +4,556 % vs target.

## Outlook
- Chip prices have a **66 % probability** of rising in the next 3 months (expected +2.17 %, 80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %) – model‑tested edge.  
- In 6 months, price‑rise probability falls to **52 %** (expected +4.34 %, 80 % range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %) – trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization is likely to tighten: 62 % chance in 3 months (expected +1.82 pts) and 60 % in 6 months (expected +3.64 pts), both baseline forecasts.  
- Buy‑timing guidance: lock pricing for parts listed under “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)”; buy ahead for the longer‑lead “Buy ahead / lock pricing” list.

## Negotiation angle
1. **Push for price locks** on the 20+ parts flagged for “Lock pricing” (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to hedge the 65 % upside risk while avoiding inventory buildup.  
2. **Demand explicit lead‑time commitments** (or penalty clauses) for the five watchlist items with 52‑week factory lead times; use the 12‑week norm as a benchmark.  
3. **Leverage the high confidence in supply‑risk scores** to negotiate volume discounts now, before any further tightening from TSMC loading or Korea export surges.
